comment: Evidence that can NEVER be verified, quarantined explicitly instead of failing forever.
Add an entry only when no future ledger run could turn the finding green: the producer run
or its artifact is gone, or a head's authoritative image work was destroyed rather than
merely superseded (superseded heads are classified automatically and need no entry).
Every entry needs an owning issue and an expiry; the auditor FAILS on an expired tombstone,
so a quarantine cannot become permanent by neglect. Widening thresholds is not an
alternative to an entry here, and neither is deleting a failing receipt class.
kind=receipt needs producer_run_id; kind=image-outcome needs head_sha.

tombstones.reason: Native Image Impact Observation for PR #6544 (FCL relicense, head 1fbdcd87, 8,054 changed paths) wrote a 2,719,460-byte receipt, over the auditor's 2 MiB cap. The artifact is immutable and can never verify; it leaves the 7-day receipt window on 2026-10-31T11:36Z. Remove this entry after that.
